services.name: Private Boat Rentals
services.desc: Rent a Private Boat Rentals on Lake Travis for your exclusive celebration! Choose from our fleet of premium boats accommodating 1-75 guests. Everything set up when you arrive - professional captain, crew, sound system, coolers, and complete customization. Three package levels from Standard to Ultimate. Starting at $200/hour with 4-hour minimum. Perfect for Bachelor Party Cruises, Bachelorette Party Cruises, Corporate Events, and more! Choose the perfect boat for your group size and celebration style. Great alternative to ATX Disco Cruise if you want complete exclusivity: Choose from three package levels - each one scales perfectly to your group size and boat selection: Private boat rentals

blurb: Guests can rent private party boats for exclusive use or join the ATX Disco Cruise, a multi-group party with DJ and photographer. Boats accommodate groups from 1 to 75 people with premium amenities and licensed captains. The company specializes in bachelor/bachelorette parties, corporate events, and other celebrations on Lake Travis.

quotes.author: Anna L.
quotes.text: 25th anniversary on The Irony at sunset. Captain ran at idle for our dinner so the wine glasses stayed put. Photographer boarded as a "fellow guest" 15 min early and captured the surprise toast. Premier coordinated everything.

quotes.author: Sarah K.
quotes.text: The trip-highlight day every bachelorette weekend should be built around. Captain handled everything; we just enjoyed the lake. Photographer caught the golden-hour stop at Devil's Cove perfectly. Worth every dollar.

quotes.author: James R.
quotes.text: Texas BBQ catered to the marina, BYOB cooler pre-stocked by Party On Delivery, Captain Wes routed us to a quiet cove instead of Devil's Cove because we wanted to actually hear each other. Best Saturday of the trip.

quotes.author: Diane W.
quotes.text: Three generations on Clever Girl — grandparents on the upper deck, kids swimming off the back, parents in the middle. Anderson Mill Marina has zero stairs which made boarding trivial for grandma with her walker.

quotes.author: Marcus T.
quotes.text: Booked Day Tripper for a 14-person board offsite. COI in 24 hours, paid by corporate card with a 25% deposit, captain ran audio at conversation level the whole time. Repeating annually.
